_note: MINERVA Aqawan 1 (roll-off; holds T1 and T2, which cannot collide).
One file for the enclosure, read by both services (robofast_core/config.py):
Every address is a 127.0.0.1 placeholder: replace it on the control network.
dome: the Aqawan Alpaca server (deploy/aqawan.example.json listens on 11113).
safetymonitor, observingconditions: the site weather bridge (sites/minerva/weather.yaml listens on 11111).
t1, t2: ASCOM Remote on each telescope's Windows PC, serving its mount (PWI4) and camera as device 0.
safety and sequencer: SafetyConfig and SequencerConfig fields; omitted ones take the defaults in docs/design.md section 6.
plan: calibration frames only (taken with the enclosure closed); or run with --plan dispatch.example.json (the dispatch scheduler) or --plan targets.example.json (a static list).
site: Mt. Hopkins (minerva-control site_mtHopkins.ini), for python -m robofast_core.when (start the night at a Sun altitude; deploy/robofast-sequencer@.service).
A telescope may also name a filterwheel (an Alpaca FilterWheel) and a port_action (its Alpaca Action that selects an M3 port), and a focuser and rotator (read only, for the FITS headers).

images: every frame is saved under data_root (docs/data.md); the optics give an approximate WCS. plate_scale (arcsec per unbinned imager pixel) from minerva-control imager_t1.ini/imager_t2.ini PLATESCALE; aperture and focal length from the legacy FITS headers (control.py APTDIA, FOCALLEN). position_angle 0 (north up, east left) assumes PWI4 derotates the imager port to PA 0 as legacy did (sites/minerva/README.md: rotator offsets).
T3 and T4 are in Aqawan 2 (down) and are not listed here; their values are in instruments.json, disabled.

status_file: the sequencer's status snapshot (request API and observer console read it); operator_control: the console's pause/resume/stop directory (docs/console.md). Relative to this file here; use /var/lib/robofast in production.

safety.fault_auto_clear (JDE 2026-10-31): the supervisor clears a PAC fault itself only with both shutters closed, never an E-stop, at most once per fault_auto_clear_interval (s), alarming each time; a recurrence within it stops automatic clearing until an operator clears faults (docs/aqawan.md).
spectrograph: the KiwiSpec service (kiwispec.example.json listens on 8130); its telescopes are named T1, T2 (docs/rv_night.md). Spectrum sidecars go under images.data_root.
name: aqawan1
